title: blimmp-nf samplesheet
description: The columns of the file given to --input. One row is one sample.

name.errorMessage: A name is required on every row, and cannot contain spaces.
name.description: The sample ID. Names the output subdirectory and prefixes every file in it, so no two rows may share one.

genome_files.errorMessage: genome_files must be a path or a glob, never a bare directory.
genome_files.description: Nucleotide FASTA, gene-called with pyrodigal. One path or a glob; several matches are joined into one sequence and gene-called once. Give this or protein_files, not both.

protein_files.errorMessage: protein_files must be a path or a glob, never a bare directory.
protein_files.description: Protein FASTA, skipping pyrodigal. One path or a glob; several matches are joined into one proteome. Give this or genome_files, not both.

sigma.errorMessage: sigma is a fraction greater than 0 and no greater than 1, so 85% complete is 0.85.
sigma.description: This sample's completeness fraction. Leave blank to fall back to --sigma, or to BUSCO's measurement when --busco_lineage is given. A row with no sigma from any source is annotated and skips BLIMMP.

taxonomy.errorMessage: taxonomy must be a name BLIMMP ships priors for; BLIMMP lists the valid ones.
taxonomy.description: Which taxonomic priors to score this sample against. Leave blank to fall back to --taxonomy, or to all-bacteria priors.
